findings.note: ESPN's 2026-27 stats show Seguin with 4 assists, none on the power play, in 21 games while averaging 14:56 a game. In November he has 1 assist in 7 games at 14:07 a game. That is limited ice time and little playmaking for an assist Over.

NHL.com (Nov 20) says Dallas is 22nd in power-play goals, 25th in shots per game and not creating the expected 5-on-5 chances. It adds that Seguin is still working back from ACL surgery and is only 'showing glimpses.'

Seguin practiced and spoke to media on Nov 21, the day before the game, about building game by game after his injury. This suggests he should play, though no lineup confirmation or analyst pick on this market was found.
